kind: standalone plan/scenario model; not application, API, database, UX usability or throughput testing

dimensions.extraGroupFixtures: 1,000 form access groups for 1, 100 and 1,000 accounts, each with 3 policy variants

assumptions: Baseline groups cover every fixture form and role environments use the same environment set. T21-T26 separately test disjoint/overlapping form scopes and non-empty independent role environment scopes; these are not factorial scope dimensions.
Initial form access is group-only. The fixtures and creation transition reference existing groups, not direct user ACLs. Creating/updating memberships remains separate administrative work.
Accepted checkpoints: an eligible editor for drafts; publishing/response/erase coverage before collection; retained-data and still-enabled operations remain covered after closure.
Approval off, prod-only and all-environments are sensitivity variants, not three accepted configuration options.

Baseline collection readiness includes a specific publish request from an eligible publisher in each destination. That request needs a different eligible approver where policy applies. Drafts do not have a permanent two-publisher requirement (T33-T34). T15 is only an authorship-difference probe, not a complete approval request.

Shared means all fixture accounts explicitly hold all form roles; departmental means account rosters split by workspace and roles split within each roster. Empty workspace rosters reuse an existing account to preserve a one-person multi-workspace case.
Ineligible includes disabled or unusable provisional accounts. Logged-in presence is not required.

Ordinary removal preserves coverage. Accepted emergency suspension immediately blocks the account/sessions across all memberships, records affected duties, and may include the last administrator; authorised operator recovery is required. Tests model this without proving real token/session enforcement.
No actual forms are created and no actual approvals, erasures or exports execute. Database transaction/concurrency safety and production performance remain untested.

Administrator continuity is checked in targeted final-state fixtures, not across the baseline matrix. Exact creation allocation, initial recipient storage, approval request state transitions, actual archive transitions and real credential recovery are not implemented or end-to-end tested.

targeted.title: Two stale removal checks can jointly orphan a form
targeted.note: Counterexample: real implementation must serialise final-state checks.

targeted.title: Serialised final-state validation refuses the second removal
targeted.note: Model refusal, not a database lock test.

targeted.title: A saved draft with pending-only access has no editor
targeted.note: Demonstrates why pending-creation semantics require a decision.

targeted.title: Strict coverage would refuse suspension of a compromised sole operator
targeted.note: Correct result under strict preservation, but an unresolved security tradeoff, not an endorsed recovery policy.

targeted.title: Provisional unusable account does not count as coverage
targeted.note: Eligible means usable active account, not merely a configured role.

targeted.title: Creator assigns another editor and omits self
targeted.note: Desired final access state only; named-user storage and creation API are not implemented.

targeted.title: Erasure authority does not imply viewing/export
targeted.note: Response reading/export remains a separate capability.

targeted.title: Closed form with enabled reopening still needs operations coverage
targeted.note: Closed is not retired; only explicitly retired operations stop requiring coverage.

targeted.title: Retained responses need response-management coverage
targeted.note: Lifecycle policy is proposed; retained data cannot silently lose enabled duties.

targeted.title: 100 accounts but only one publisher is insufficient for independent approval
targeted.note: Count authorised people, not headcount.

targeted.title: Disabling the only independent publisher loses approval coverage
targeted.note: Permission and eligibility must be rechecked when an approval is applied.

targeted.title: Another group can preserve access after one membership is removed
targeted.note: Effective access is the union of remaining grants.

targeted.title: Editor inherits viewing but not creation in another workspace
targeted.note: Creation-only workspace membership is separate.

targeted.title: Erasure can be allowed in test without prod
targeted.note: Environment selection is explicit and not restricted to production.

targeted.title: One publisher different from a frozen version author can approve that exact version
targeted.note: Exact-request eligibility differs from blanket future readiness requiring two publishers. This distinction needs lifecycle/publishing-flow treatment.

targeted.title: Last active Installation administrator cannot be demoted
targeted.note: Administrator continuity is separate from form task coverage.

targeted.title: Installation privilege does not replace explicit Workspace administrator membership
targeted.note: An installation role alone does not satisfy the workspace membership invariant.

targeted.title: Atomic Workspace administrator handover preserves continuity
targeted.note: The replacement must be an eligible account; final state is checked together.

targeted.title: Disabling sole administrator affects every workspace
targeted.note: Strict continuity flags all affected duties. Emergency suspension still needs an explicit policy.

targeted.title: Two uncoordinated Workspace administrator removals can violate continuity
targeted.note: Another stale-read counterexample; no real transaction locking is tested.

targeted.title: Different form groups stay isolated within one workspace
targeted.note: Creation membership and another person's group cannot supply access to the other form.

targeted.title: Non-empty independent role environment scopes
targeted.note: Publishing=test; response reading=prod; erasure=test. Each has an allowed and refused probe.

targeted.title: Rescoping the sole F1 editing group can uncover F1
targeted.note: An ordinary-change coverage guard must refuse this state until F1 has a replacement.

targeted.title: Roles on different forms cannot combine into publishing authority
targeted.note: Editing F1 plus publishing F2 does not permit publishing F1.

targeted.title: Publisher for another form cannot supply an independent approver
targeted.note: The second person needs the exact form/environment authority.

targeted.title: Overlapping membership preserves only actual form permissions
targeted.note: The remaining F1 editor group preserves F1 editing; the F2 viewer group grants neither F2 editing nor publishing.

targeted.title: Emergency account suspension is immediate despite sole-operator coverage
targeted.note: Accepted security exception; affected actions are blocked and audited until authorised replacement.

targeted.title: One account suspension makes all group permissions ineffective without deleting memberships
targeted.note: Sessions and effective permissions are invalidated globally; memberships remain as records. This is a model transition, not an authentication integration test.

targeted.title: Emergency suspension may leave last-administrator duties uncovered for operator recovery
targeted.note: The accepted emergency exception is distinct from ordinary succession. No implicit replacement access is granted.

targeted.title: Ordinary removal still requires coverage-preserving handover
targeted.note: Emergency mode is explicit and audited; ordinary changes retain the no-orphan guard.

targeted.title: Initial approval holds the entire creation request
targeted.note: No active form or grants exist while initial approval is pending. An active eligible editor is still required before applying the request.

targeted.title: Approved creation applies form and group assignments together
targeted.note: Group-only desired-state fixture; actual transaction/approval versioning and authority remain application work.

targeted.title: A draft does not require a standing second publisher
targeted.note: Independent approval is checked when the protected action is requested, not as a permanent two-publisher form invariant.

targeted.title: Protected publishing checks a different eligible person for the exact request
targeted.note: A named requester has a different active publisher on the same form/environment; unrelated users cannot substitute.

targeted.title: Creation refuses an assigned group with no eligible editor
targeted.note: Draft editor coverage is revalidated before a form becomes active.

targeted.title: Initial publisher/view permission cannot substitute for editing
targeted.note: Viewing inherited from Publish forms does not satisfy the editor obligation.

targeted.title: Creation approval rechecks editor eligibility before committing
targeted.note: A queued request does not freeze the eligibility of its group holders.

targeted.title: Creation approval refuses a requester who lost creation permission
targeted.note: Recheck current authority at application, not merely at request submission.

targeted.title: Independent approval cannot replace missing requester permission
targeted.note: Both requester authority and a different eligible approver are rechecked for the exact protected action.
